author: baigabdullah
quote:
I created an account just to provide a review on this piece of sh**.

Grand Theft Auto? Are you kidding me? To all the people that are saying that most reviewers haven't played the game. Well I have, and I will be honest

+ Yes, the open world is beautiful 
- But guys this is not Grand Theft Auto !!!!!!!!!!!!!! PERIOD !!!!

Why am I repairing a home? Buying Flowers? What's the point of doing such things in a GTA setting. I am honestly not judging, I understand the new generation (gen z) would prefer such games with diversity, lgbtq, political correctness but they have no place in Grand Theft Auto.
